request.prompt:
Exact SAME blue crystal golem from both references: same pointed crystalline head/eyes, massive faceted shoulders, long bulky crystal fists, V chest, stout jointed legs/flat feet, cobalt/sapphire and icy-white facets, same detailed painted2D RPG model and isometric camera. Solid blue joint connections keep head, torso, arms, hands, hips and feet attached. No different robot, clothes, weapon, hair or tail. CONSTANT character proportions/physical scale. Alpha ZERO off the complete figures, no particles/debris/fog/floor/shadow, no cropped spikes/fists/toes or neighboring-pose contamination. Broad transparent gutters. Real joint movement, no global rotate/scale/mirror copies.
Exactly SIX figures in THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, wide spacious landscape. Top row faces N/BACK, bottom row NE/back-right; these are actual back views of the same crystal anatomy, no front face/chest pasted on its back. Columns: ANTICIPATION (grounded rear support, hips/shoulder/elbow wind the heavy right crystal fist), CONTACT (whole-body weight shifts into front support as the connected right shoulder/elbow/wrist/fist strikes forward in that facing direction), RECOVERY (connected elbow withdraws, knees/hips settle toward idle). Both arms and both legs remain anatomically joined even where naturally occluded. No floating/disembodied fist, sword, effects or loose crystals. Keep same model/head size and leave generous transparent padding around the full extended body in every cell; never overlap a neighboring body's rectangle. Only6 poses.
